article.story: HUNTSVILLE, Texas -- — Narit Chotikavanic's 24 points helped SFA defeat Abilene Christian 76-66 on Friday. Chotikavanic shot 8 for 11, including 8 for 10 from beyond the arc for the Lumberjacks (4-0). Lateef Patrick shot 6 of 11 from the field, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 6 from the line to add 18 points. Keon Thompson shot 4 of 12 from the field and 7 for 10 from the line to finish with 15 points, while adding 12 rebounds and six assists. Yaniel Rivera led the way for the Wildcats (3-1) with 19 points. Abilene Christian also got 12 points and eight rebounds from Chilaydrien Newton. Rich Smith had 10 points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
